name: Ling Yun Industrial Corporation Limited
summary: Ling Yun Industrial Corporation Limited engages in the production and sale of automotive parts and plastic piping systems in China and internationally. It offers sensor, single door ring, steel anti-collision beam, liquid cooling system battery, steel-aluminum hybrid battery casing, bending strength beam, aluminum alloy anti-collision beam, energy storage cabinet cooling systems, thermoformed products, decorative seals, front and rear drive shaft, front and rear bumper crossbeams, cab suspension system, automative nylon tubing, side door anti-collision beam, and body stamping welding parts.
